service.method: SELECT CODE AS CONT_NO ,SEQ AS CONT_GL_SEQ FROM SDCAM WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND TYPE = 'CONT' GROUP BY CODE, SEQ
SELECT USER_ID , COMPANY_CODE FROM SUSMT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND WORK_TYPE = 'Z'
SELECT CTRL_PERSON_ID AS USER_ID , COMPANY_CODE FROM SBALN WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND CTRL_CODE ='QnA_MANAGER'

SELECT DISTINCT USMT.COMPANY_CODE , USMT.USER_ID FROM SUSMT CREATOR_USMT INNER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON CREATOR_USMT.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND CREATOR_USMT.COMPANY_CODE = USMT.COMPANY_CODE AND CREATOR_USMT.DEPT = USMT.DEPT INNER JOIN SCODE CODE ON CODE.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND CODE.TYPE = 'UX050' AND CODE.LANGUAGE = ${session.LANGUAGE} AND CODE.CODE = USMT.RESPONSIBILITY WHERE CREATOR_USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND CREATOR_USMT.COMPANY_CODE = ${CREATOR_COMPANY_CODE} AND CREATOR_USMT.USER_ID = ${CREATOR_USER_ID} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(USMT.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
